verses.text: A song of ascents. They’ve caused me pain over and over since I was young. Let Israel say it now:
They’ve caused me pain over and over since I was young, but they haven’t beaten me.
They plowed across my back, cutting long furrows.
The LORD does what’s right. He cut the ropes of the wicked.
Let everyone who hates Zion be put to shame and turned back.
Let them be like grass on a roof, drying up before it has a chance to grow.
Nobody harvesting gets even a handful of it. Nobody tying bundles gets an armful.
People walking past don’t say, “The LORD bless you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”
